svg.title: Walls, doors, accesses and stairs — img19
svg.desc: Editable manual architectural trace of OriginalFloorplan/img19.jpg, using its original 1395 by 1040 image coordinates. Four layers contain walls and structural columns, doors and their swings, access thresholds, and three staircases. No embedded raster, room labels, furniture, fixtures, floor patterns, room colors, window swings, clearance circles or site annotations. Source labels conceal some short wall sections; these are approximately reconstructed from adjacent visible geometry. No surveyed scale or dimensional accuracy is asserted.
